description: Return the shopper's saved default size and fit. Call this BEFORE asking the user for a size — if a default is set, apply it automatically (add_to_cart uses it when size is omitted), and search in their fit: search_products style='oversized' for oversized, style='tee' for basic. Once the account keeps the person's AI tools choice it also returns ai_opt_in: the AI tools switch, which decides access for designers and admins only — a shopper's AI tools stay on whatever it says.
name: get_user_prefs

ai_opt_in.description: The AI tools switch: their own choice, otherwise on for shoppers and admins and off for designers. It decides access for designers and admins; shoppers keep AI tools either way. Absent while the account does not keep this choice yet.

fit.description: Saved fit preference: basic | oversized, or null.

title: Get saved preferences
